commands: run=$(ls -td runs/kofi/*/ | head -1); run=${run#runs/}; run=${run%/}; steps=$(python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["total_steps"] + 8000)' "runs/$run/config.json"); LAB_ACTOR=Kofi tools/runs resume "$run" --to "$steps"
run=$(ls -td runs/kofi/*/ | head -1); printf '\n%s, Kofi: the loss had not flattened at the last step, so this run gets 8000 more steps tonight.\n' "$(date '+%F %H:%M')" >> "${run}NOTES.md"
